description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

At DiDi, we are building something special, and we want the world to know it. We believe in creativity, connection, and the power of a killer digital strategy. We’re looking for a creative, internet-obsessed, and driven Social Media Intern to join our Regional Social Media Marketing team.

If you live on TikTok, know exactly why a specific audio is trending, and understand how community drives brand loyalty, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.

In this role, you'll be...

As our Social Media Intern, you won't just be fetching coffee or scheduling boring posts. You will be in the driver’s seat of our community presence, helping us scale our hyper-local footprints and collaborating with incredible creators. You will work closely with our core marketing team and external agency partners to turn big ideas into viral realities.

Key Responsibilities


Community Management: Be the voice of our brand. You’ll engage with our followers, spark conversations, and turn casual scrollers into brand evangelists.
Influencer Marketing Management: Source, approve and review local and macro-influencers. You'll manage the outreach pipeline and ensure creators deliver content that hits the mark in partnership with our influencer agency. 
City-Based Campaigns: You will assist in brainstorming and executing hyper-targeted, city-specific campaigns to build local buzz and offline-to-online engagement.
Agency Coordination: Act as a bridge between our internal team and our paid media agency. You'll help coordinate our boosting/paid social efforts to ensure our top-performing organic content gets the budget it deserves.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


Unapologetic Passion: You genuinely love social media and influencer culture. You understand the nuances of different platforms (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube) and what makes content shareable.
A Creative Mindset: You can spot trends before they hit the mainstream and know how to adapt them to a brand voice.
Organization Skills: Juggling multiple influencers and city campaigns requires a sharp eye for detail and great time management.
Analytical Curiosity: Note: While basic knowledge of social analytics is a massive plus to help us track our social media impact, it is not mandatory. We are more than happy to teach you the ropes if you bring the data-curious mindset!



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. You will have responsibility for partnering with a small number of assigned accounts, maintaining a continual focus on the customer’s business goals to improve their overall technical and operational health and realize the maximum value out of their Salesforce investment. The Customer Success Manager maintains awareness of the customer's key events, needs, potential risks, and value drivers.

As a trusted advisor, the CSM will build a track record in customer success through superb communication with partners and extensive knowledge of the Salesforce platform to translate their business needs to solutions. You will forge relationships with your customers and account teams, develop a deep technical understanding of their Salesforce implementation, share standard methodologies, and adoption of proactive services. These activities will enable you to proactively set the customer up for success through optimization of the platform, with special care during critically important peak events.

As a CSM, you will occasionally act as a point of contact for any major incidents, owning the customer’s expectations and communications through the resolution of such incidents. The CSM acts as the technical main interface on behalf of our customers and works closely across both internal and external collaborators, including partners and ISVs, as required to address the customer needs.

The ideal CSM has an extraordinary focus on the success of the customer, is an exceptional communicator, exhibits professionalism, is dedicated to meeting and exceeding expectations, enjoys forming relationships, has excellent collaboration skills, and has the ability to learn new technologies quickly.

Cultivate and maintain stakeholder relationships with the customer’s IT and business executive leadership, sponsors, and decision-makers within customer organizations that have purchased Signature.

Act as an advocate for customers during the triage and resolution of high severity cases to assist with the timely resolution of these issues.
Proactive Support & Enhancement: Conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.

The CSM may be required to occasionally be available for some after-hour or weekend coverage depending on the customer’s need.

The Customer Success team within Signature Success is looking for a driven and customer-focused Customer Success Manager (CSM) to serve as a primary contact point for Salesforce’s largest and highest-profile customers. Unleash Your Potential

About the job

Remote - Independent Contractor




This opportunity is intended for experienced Growth Marketing leaders who have personally owned customer acquisition, managed significant marketing investments, and driven measurable commercial growth for scalable digital businesses.




This is not a campaign management or channel specialist role.




We're looking for a senior Growth Marketing professional with demonstrated ownership of commercial outcomes, strategic decision-making, and the ability to build growth systems from the ground up.




You should be comfortable operating at both the strategic and execution levels while partnering directly with executive leadership in a fast-moving, early-stage environment.




Help build the growth engine of an emerging digital business.




An emerging direct-to-consumer business is seeking an experienced Growth Marketing leader to define, build, and scale its commercial growth function from an early stage.




Rather than inheriting established teams or mature processes, you'll help build the commercial foundation that supports long-term, scalable growth.




We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex business challenges, creating structure where little exists, making thoughtful decisions with incomplete information, and taking ownership of measurable business outcomes.




If you're motivated by building, influencing strategic direction, and delivering meaningful business impact, we'd like to hear from you.

 




Key Responsibilities




Define and execute the company’s growth strategy across customer acquisition, conversion, and retention.
Partner with executive leadership to establish commercial priorities and growth initiatives.
Develop customer acquisition strategies across multiple digital channels.
Design, execute, and continuously improve experimentation frameworks to optimize growth performance.
Build KPI frameworks, reporting systems, and performance dashboards that support effective business decisions.
Identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, operational effectiveness, and commercial performance.
Build scalable operating processes that support sustainable long-term growth.
Contribute to organizational planning as future growth capabilities are developed.




What We’re Looking For




We’re interested in professionals who have demonstrated ownership of business results—not simply marketing execution.




Ideal candidates will typically bring:




Experience leading Growth, Performance Marketing, Demand Generation, Customer Acquisition, or similar commercial growth functions.
A proven ability to connect marketing strategy with measurable business outcomes.
Experience managing meaningful digital advertising investments and making commercially sound decisions supported by data.
Strong understanding of acquisition funnels, customer behavior, attribution, experimentation, conversion optimization, and performance analytics.
The ability to move comfortably between strategic planning and hands-on execution.
Demonstrated ability to influence business decisions beyond marketing execution.
Strong commercial judgment, analytical thinking, and decision-making skills.
Excellent English communication skills.
The ability to perform effectively in dynamic, fast-changing environments.




Experience in consumer technology, digital health, wellness, subscription businesses, marketplaces, SaaS, or other direct-to-consumer businesses is highly valued.




What Success Looks Like




Success in this role means helping build a sustainable growth function—not simply delivering campaigns.




The successful candidate will be expected to:




Build scalable growth systems that support long-term business objectives.
Improve customer acquisition efficiency through disciplined experimentation.
Strengthen commercial decision-making using meaningful performance data.
Create operational clarity through effective reporting and measurable KPIs.
Serve as a trusted strategic partner to executive leadership.
Drive measurable business impact while maintaining a hands-on approach to execution.




Selection Process




Our hiring process is intentionally designed to evaluate more than experience alone.




We’re interested in professionals who demonstrate ownership, strategic thinking, sound business judgment, execution capability, and the ability to build in evolving environments.




The process includes conversations with the recruitment team and executive leadership. Candidates who advance through the process may be invited to participate in additional evaluation steps designed to better understand their approach to business challenges, decision-making, communication, and growth strategy.




This opportunity is intended for professionals who are energized by ownership, accountability, and the challenge of building something meaningful from an early stage—not by organizational hierarchy alone.




 Compensation




Independent Contractor

Remote (Mexico preferred)

Annual base compensation: USD $50,000




In addition to the annual base compensation, the role includes the opportunity to participate in a performance-based incentive structure designed to reward exceptional business results and long-term value creation.




For top-performing individuals, total annual compensation has the potential to range from approximately USD $150,000 to USD $250,000+ annually, subject to individual performance, business results, and the terms of any incentive plans approved by the Company.




Additional compensation may include one or more of the following:




Performance-based incentives

Revenue or profit-sharing opportunities

Long-term incentive arrangements

Other business performance awards approved by the Company.




Any additional compensation shall be governed exclusively by the applicable Offer Letter and/or any written incentive plan approved by the Company.




Shortlisted candidates will receive additional information regarding the next stages of the selection process.

description:
About the job

Location: Mexico (preferred) | Hybrid / Remote




About Sarelly




Sarelly is building more than a beauty brand—we're building an entertainment and culture-driven beauty company designed for the next generation of Latina consumers.

As we expand into the U.S., we're investing in a new capability: an AI-powered Consumer Intelligence Hub that continuously transforms consumer signals into better business decisions.

Rather than relying on traditional research, we're building a proprietary intelligence system that combines first-party data, social conversations, creator communities, AI and strategic thinking to guide Product, Brand, Growth and Retail.

We're looking for someone to lead that capability.




The Opportunity




This is not a traditional Consumer & Market Insights role.

You won't spend your time commissioning surveys and writing research reports.

Instead, you'll build and own Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence function, working at the intersection of consumer understanding, AI and business strategy.

Your mission is simple: Turn consumer signals into better business decisions.

Working alongside an external AI Intelligence Architect and the executive team, you'll help build one of the first AI-native Consumer Intelligence capabilities in beauty.




Key Responsibilities




Build Sarelly's Consumer Intelligence Framework




Define and continuously refine Sarelly's proprietary consumer taxonomy.
Organize consumer signals around business questions rather than platforms.
Ensure our AI systems are trained to identify meaningful consumer patterns instead of simply reporting data.
Continuously improve the quality and relevance of our intelligence model.










Define the AI Intelligence Architect




You'll lead the building of the technical infrastructure: 

Define how raw consumer data should be categorized and tagged.
Brief AI workflows and prompting frameworks.
Validate AI outputs
Identify new data sources that should be integrated into the system.










Translate Intelligence into Business Recommendations




You'll synthesize consumer intelligence into executive recommendations.

Your recommendations will directly influence:

Product Innovation
Franchise Development
Marketing
Creator Strategy
CRM
Retail










What Success Looks Like




Identify emerging consumer needs before competitors.
Translate consumer language into stronger messaging.
Identify product innovation opportunities earlier.
Improve creator selection and content strategy.
Make faster, evidence-based business decisions.










Become the Internal Expert on Latina Consumers




Help Sarelly develop the deepest understanding of Latina beauty consumers in the industry.

This includes understanding differences across:

Cultural identities
Heritage groups
Beauty routines
Consumer language
Shopping behaviors
Generations
Geographic markets
Emerging cultural trends

Rather than treating the Latina consumer as one audience, you'll help us understand the nuances that drive relevance.




Build a Learning Organization




Champion a culture of curiosity across the company. Help teams move from reporting observations to generating insights and making better business decisions.




Required Experience




2-3 

years in Consumer Insights, Innovation.
Experience working with multicultural or diverse consumer audiences.
Strong qualitative and strategic thinking skills.
Experience translating consumer research into business recommendations.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills.
Fluent in English and Spanish.










Preferred Experience




Strong preference for candidates with experience in one or more of the following:

Beauty or personal care
Consumer packaged goods
Creator economy
Community-led brands
Consumer innovation
Consumer segmentation
U.S. Hispanic / Latina consumers
Mexican and U.S. markets

Experience across different Latina sub-communities and target demographics is highly valued.




AI Requirements (Must Have)




We are intentionally building an AI-native Consumer Intelligence function.

You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be highly AI-literate.

You should be comfortable:

Working daily with Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI tools.
Developing prompts and AI workflows.
Validating AI-generated insights.
Using AI to accelerate research and synthesis.
Rethinking traditional research methods through AI rather than simply replicating existing processes.

Curiosity about AI and willingness to experiment are essential.




Skills




Consumer research
Strategic thinking
Hypothesis generation
Pattern recognition
Cultural analysis
Storytelling
AI literacy
Project management
Cross-functional collaboration










Mindset




We're looking for someone who:

Is endlessly curious about people.
Naturally connects dots that others miss.
Questions assumptions before accepting them.
Loves experimenting with AI.
Enjoys building systems, not just reports.
Thinks like a strategist, not only a researcher.
Wants to help build a capability that doesn't yet exist.










Why Join Sarelly?




This is a rare opportunity to build the Consumer Intelligence function from the ground up.

Rather than inheriting traditional research processes, you'll help define how AI and human judgment work together to create a structural competitive advantage for one of the most culturally relevant beauty brands in the market.

description:
About the job

Enrollment Specialist - Inside Sales, Healthcare Financing




About United Credit




United Credit helps healthcare providers grow their practices by making patient financing simple.




Unlike single-lender financing companies, United Credit gives providers access to multiple financing options through one application, helping more patients get approved while allowing providers to offer financing that fits a wider range of credit profiles. Our merchant partners rely on us not just for financing, but for responsive service, industry expertise, and a true partnership focused on helping their businesses grow.




We’re a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company where ideas become action quickly. We value accountability, collaboration, and people who take ownership of their work. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and making a measurable impact every day, you’ll fit right in.




Position Summary




The Enrollment Specialist is responsible for generating new merchant enrollments by engaging healthcare providers, qualifying opportunities, guiding practices through the enrollment process, and creating a seamless onboarding experience. Reporting to the Sales Manager, this role serves as the first impression of United Credit and plays a critical role in growing our provider network. This is a high-activity, performance-driven inside sales role focused primarily on new enrollments, with a secondary responsibility of reactivating assigned accounts.




Essential Responsibilities




● Own the entire enrollment pipeline from initial outreach through underwriting approval.

● Work consumer-sourced leads where a patient has inquired about financing through United Credit but their provider is not yet enrolled: proactively contact the provider by phone and email, let them know a patient is actively seeking financing, and pitch enrollment in the United Credit platform.

● Make outbound calls daily and respond to inbound leads in a timely manner, maintaining high speed-to-lead standards since providers can choose a competitor within minutes.

● Focus on reaching decision-makers (owners, office managers, providers) and qualify opportunities through meaningful conversations that lead to next steps.

● Consistently overcome objections from providers currently using competitors such as Cherry, CareCredit, Proceed Finance, and HFD.

● Guide providers step-by-step through the enrollment process, including sending the digital enrollment link and clearly communicating required documents (driver’s license, proof of banking, 3 months of bank statements, and medical/business license).

● Ensure all documentation is accurate and complete, then submit applications and move accounts to underwriting for approval.

● Create urgency around provider onboarding to reduce enrollment cycle time.

● Set qualified appointments for Business Development Managers, confirm attendance, and position calls as valuable (training, growth, increased approvals).

● Complete 5-10 meaningful follow-ups daily on incomplete enrollments, missing documents, and no-response prospects, maintaining persistence without being pushy.

● Collaborate closely with Business Development Managers to ensure a seamless transition after activation.

● Contact assigned accounts to reintroduce United Credit, highlight program improvements, and encourage submission of new applications.

● Log all activity in Salesforce with detailed notes and next steps, and keep a clean, prioritized pipeline while managing multiple accounts simultaneously.

● Set and meet weekly and monthly enrollment and appointment targets, contributing to overall loan volume growth.

● Perform other duties as assigned.




Performance Metrics (KPIs)

● Calls: 50+ daily

● Talk Time: 2+ hours daily (live conversations only; voicemail/hold time does not count)

● Live Conversations: 8-12 per day

● Appointments Set: 2-4 daily, 10-20 per week

● Follow-Ups: 5-10 daily

● New merchant enrollments and enrollment cycle time

● Enrollment-to-activation conversion rate




What Success Looks Like

● You build trusted relationships with healthcare providers.

● You move quickly and follow through on commitments.

● You solve problems rather than waiting for direction.

● You use data to prioritize your day and keep your pipeline moving.

● You consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

● You contribute ideas that improve the merchant experience.




Required Skills

● Strong phone presence with the ability to drive high call volume and meaningful talk time.

● Consultative, relationship-driven sales approach rather than a transactional one; comfort with solution selling.

● Excellent follow-up discipline and a sense of urgency, given how quickly providers can choose a competing financing option.

● Ability to manage and prioritize a multi-account sales pipeline independently.

● Comfort working in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

● Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with documentation.

● Coachable, consistent, and self-motivated, even on slow days.

● Healthcare sales, medical sales, or patient financing experience is a strong plus.




Work Location & Hours

● Fully remote position open to international candidates, with preference for Mexico-based candidates.

● Full-time.




United Credit is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of United Credit to provide all persons with equal employment and educational opportunities without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, gender, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, religion or similar factors as defined by law.

Docdigitales es una empresa SaaS creciendo aceleradamente en administración financiera, con distintas plataformas para negocios, emprendedores y contadores.




Nuestra plataforma consta de dos verticales de producto, y buscamos un Product Designer que tome ownership completo del diseño de una de ellas. No es una posición de management: es un rol de contribución individual, con reporte directo al CEO.




No buscamos a alguien que construya el roadmap desde cero — eso lo definimos junto con CEO y Producto. Lo que sí necesitamos es a alguien que, una vez que la dirección está clara, avance solo/a: que no necesite seguimiento constante para entregar, y que responda con la velocidad que el tamaño de este equipo requiere. Autonomía real es el filtro más importante de esta posición — más que años de experiencia.




Qué vas a hacer:

Diseñar end-to-end las funcionalidades de tu vertical: research, propuesta, iteración y ejecución final.
Trabajar de cerca con CEO e Ingeniería para llevar el diseño a producción sin necesitar supervisión paso a paso.
Tener voz en las prioridades de tu vertical — qué se ataca primero y por qué — aunque la dirección estratégica venga definida junto con CEO y Producto.
Coordinar con el otro Product Designer del equipo para mantener consistencia entre las dos verticales de la plataforma.
Tomar decisiones de diseño con criterio propio, y comunicar de forma proactiva cuando algo se traba, en lugar de dejar que el tiempo pase sin avisar.



Buscamos a alguien con:

3–5 años de experiencia diseñando producto de software, idealmente SaaS.
Experiencia sólida en aplicaciones web. Indispensable.
Evidencia real de haber trabajado con autonomía: entregas a tiempo sin supervisión constante, comunicación proactiva cuando algo se complica, y buen juicio para saber cuándo avanzar solo/a y cuándo preguntar.
Capacidad de operar con ambigüedad razonable — la dirección te la damos, la ejecución y las decisiones del día a día son tuyas.
Comunicación directa y rápida: este es un equipo pequeño, sin capas, donde la velocidad de respuesta importa tanto como la calidad del diseño.




Deseable:

Experiencia previa en startups o equipos pequeños, donde tuviste que resolver con pocos recursos y poca estructura.
Haber colaborado directamente con founders o C-level.




Lo que ofrecemos:

Un rol con impacto directo y visible en el negocio, no diseño decorativo.
Acceso directo a quien toma decisiones (CEO) y acompañamiento real en la parte estratégica del producto.
Compensación competitiva para el nivel del rol.

About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across voice, email, and enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z and Base10 with over $60M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments - where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About The Role

At HappyRobot, our partners are a core growth engine — but only if we're rigorous about which opportunities we chase and disciplined about setting partners up to win.

We're looking for a Partnerships Strategy & Enablement Lead to build the system that turns raw partner-sourced opportunities into a prioritized, well-scoped pipeline, and to build the enablement that lets partners qualify, sell, and deploy on their own.

This is a high-ownership, cross-functional role sitting at the intersection of strategy, commercial structuring, and partner operations. You'll be the person who decides what's worth pursuing, builds the case for it, and makes sure it actually gets delivered.

What We're Looking For


1–3 years of experience in Management Consulting, Strategy, Business Operations, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Chief of Staff, or a high-growth startup
Exceptional structured problem-solving skills
Highly analytical with strong Excel / Google Sheets modeling abilities

Partner directly with the Head of LATAM on the region's highest-priority strategic initiatives — market research, competitive analysis, business cases, and financial models to support expansion into new markets, customers, and partnerships
Build and continuously improve LATAM's operating cadence: dashboards and reporting across sales, deployments, customers, recruiting, and operations, plus the documentation, processes, and playbooks that let the team scale
Drive cross-functional execution — coordinating Sales, Deployments, Engineering, Marketing, Recruiting, and Finance to move initiatives from idea to execution, unblock dependencies, and keep the team focused on what matters most

Why join us?


Opportunity to work at a high-growth AI startup, backed by top investors
Rapidly growing and backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, and Base10
Ownership & Autonomy - Take full ownership of projects and ship fast
Top-Tier Compensation - Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup
Comprehensive Benefits - Healthcare, dental, vision coverage
Work With the Best - Join a world-class team of engineers and builders


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it's not "your job." If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don't wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for "just fine." We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it's a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody's watching.

We are "majos"

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. "Majo" is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We're building something ambitious, and it's easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We're running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; 'exceptional performance is the passing grade.' Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that's how we win.

First-Principles Thinking 

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don't copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It's how we build what others think is impossible.

About the job

About United Credit




United Credit helps healthcare providers grow their practices by making patient financing simple.




Unlike single-lender financing companies, United Credit gives providers access to multiple financing options through one application, helping more patients get approved while allowing providers to offer financing that fits a wider range of credit profiles. Our merchant partners rely on us not just for financing, but for responsive service, industry expertise, and a true partnership focused on helping their businesses grow.




We’re a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company where ideas become action quickly. We value accountability, collaboration, and people who take ownership of their work. If you’re someone who enjoys solving problems, building relationships, and making a measurable impact every day, you’ll fit right in.




Position Summary




The Business Development Manager is responsible for driving growth within an assigned portfolio of healthcare providers. Through consultative account management, strategic business reviews, staff training, performance analysis, and relationship development, the BDM helps providers increase financing utilization, improve patient conversion, and maximize the value of their partnership with United Credit. Reporting to the Sales Manager, this role is about growing and protecting an existing book of business, not new-account hunting.




Essential Responsibilities




● Conduct business reviews with assigned merchants using Salesforce dashboards and portfolio analytics to identify growth opportunities.

● Identify underperforming accounts and develop action plans to increase funded volume and merchant activation.

● Train providers and office staff on financing best practices, patient conversation scripts, and program utilization.

● Increase merchant activation and application utilization across the assigned territory.

● Analyze funding trends within the portfolio and recommend strategies to improve loan volume and share of wallet.

● Establish and maintain executive relationships with owners, providers, office managers, and practice administrators.

● Educate merchants on UC programs, benefits, rates, and compliance requirements to ensure a high level of program knowledge.

● Protect merchant retention by proactively identifying competitive threats and addressing provider concerns before they become churn risk.

● Collaborate with Enrollment Specialists to ensure a smooth merchant handoff after activation.

● Partner with Operations to resolve merchant issues quickly and maintain a high standard of merchant satisfaction.

● Introduce program changes and enhancements to assigned accounts, including new lender additions, pricing tiers, or platform features.

● Maintain working knowledge of the patient and healthcare financing industry, including competitor offerings (Cherry, CareCredit, Proceed Finance, HFD, Alphaeon, and similar providers), so you can speak credibly to how United Credit compares.

● Represent the company at industry trade shows and meetings, as needed.

● Perform other duties as assigned.




Performance Metrics (KPIs)

● Monthly funded loan volume within assigned portfolio

● Active merchant percentage

● Merchant utilization rate (applications per active merchant)

● Merchant retention and reactivation

● Share of wallet within assigned accounts

● Business reviews completed

● Training sessions conducted

● Salesforce activity completion




What Success Looks Like

● You build trusted relationships with healthcare providers.

● You move quickly and follow through on commitments.

● You solve problems rather than waiting for direction.

● You use data to prioritize your day and identify growth opportunities within your portfolio.

● You consistently meet or exceed activity and performance goals.

● You contribute ideas that improve the merchant experience.




Required Skills

● 2+ years of account management, portfolio management, or relationship management experience required; experience in healthcare sales, patient financing, medical sales, or practice development is a strong plus.

● Excellent phone and communication skills (50+ calls per day, 2+ hours of talk time daily).

● Consultative selling and solution-selling skills, with the ability to build and execute account growth plans rather than simply respond to requests.

● Ability to handle provider communications in a friendly, professional, and timely manner across phone, email, and text.

● Ability to be both a team player in a collaborative environment and an independent contributor.

● Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and adapt as the competitive landscape shifts.

● Strong time management and territory management skills.

● Expert use of computers and typing, with knowledge of Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.

● Fluent, professional-level written and verbal English skills.

● Work experience utilizing Salesforce or a comparable CRM, including dashboards and portfolio analytics.

● Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field, preferred.




Work Location & Hours

● Fully remote position open to international candidates, with preference for Mexico-based candidates.

● Full-time.




United Credit is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of United Credit to provide all persons with equal employment and educational opportunities without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, gender, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, religion or similar factors as defined by law.

This is also a team role. You are working alongside writers, editors, and designers who are all building toward the same goal. How the content performs is tied to what you bring.

Handle ideation for 15+ channels. Research ideas, find outliers, write title options, build the thumbnail concept and direction, write the logline, and complete the video outline.
Review every script before it reaches a client. Check the hook, the CTAs, and the conclusion. If something is off, fix it or flag it clearly.
Review every thumbnail before it is finalized. Evaluate the concept, the strategy, and whether it earns the click. If the direction is wrong, say why.
Be on every client call with your Pod Leader. Take real-time notes, add ideas into Notion as the conversation happens, and have a clean action item list ready when the call ends.
Show up to team meetings knowing your numbers and ready to contribute.




Results

60%+ of all ideas for your team are created by you
90%+ of ideas you create are approved by the Pod Leader on the first pass
90%+ of scripts reviewed before they reach a client
90%+ of thumbnails reviewed before they ship
Brief quality improves consistently over time, tracked through Pod Leader feedback




Requirements

Built and managed content across multiple channels or clients simultaneously, where the details were yours to get right
Developed a repeatable ideation process using data, not just gut feel -- can walk through how they find outlier ideas and what makes them confident in one
Reviewed creative work (scripts, thumbnails, or similar) before it reached an audience and caught problems others missed
Worked inside a team-based production environment where missing a deadline affected other people downstream
Can demonstrate a real understanding of YouTube: how videos get traction, what makes a hook land, and how a video generates a lead




Who This Is For: This role is genuinely creative. You are coming up with ideas for 15+ channels every month and those ideas have to keep working for each client over time. You are not just generating volume. You are staying curious about what is performing, watching what other channels are doing, and bringing back ideas that are actually good.




You also have to be organized. There is a lot of independent work here and none of it waits for someone to remind you. You are tracking briefs, reviews, and deadlines across multiple clients at once.




If you like doing deep research, get genuinely excited about finding a concept you know is going to work, and can keep that level of attention across a full client load, this role will feel like a good fit.




It's not for you if you need a lot of direction to get started, want to be making final decisions right now, or do not want to work closely as part of a team.




Schedule: Monday through Friday, core hours aligned with 8am to 5pm Eastern. Some client calls may require flexibility within that window. (Some hours are flexible based on timezone)




Location: Fully remote. Open to candidates internationally




Compensation: $36,000 to $42,000 base salary depending on experience. Reviewed annually. Compensation grows with performance. We are building a performance model where hitting your numbers and continuing to take on more gets rewarded directly. All positions start with a 30 to 90 day paid trial.




Our Core Values

Relentless Curiosity - Learning never stops. You enjoy growth personally and professionally.
Kind Candor - Honest feedback both internally and externally is a gift we gladly receive.
Extreme Ownership - Be the type of person people can always count on, both internally and externally.
Operational Excellence - Be the person who spots what is broken and makes it better.

description:
About the job

All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.


About JumpCloud®


JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.




 


JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.






About the Role


JumpCloud is building an AI-first GTM engine designed to scale pipeline generation through automation, intelligent workflows, and operational leverage. This role will focus on the next evolution of outbound execution by combining AI, automation, data orchestration, and modern GTM tooling to build scalable outbound systems that improve efficiency, personalization, and pipeline generation.




This is a hands-on builder role focused on deploying production-ready workflows, not just experimenting with AI tools. You will partner closely with Marketing, Sales Development, and Operations leadership to create agentic outbound programs that connect data, AI, sequencing, enrichment, and engagement systems into a unified outbound motion.




You will help operationalize how modern outbound gets built at scale.







What You'll Be Doing:


Reporting to the Sr. Director of Marketing Operations, this role will focus on designing, building, and operationalizing agentic outbound systems that improve pipeline generation efficiency and seller productivity.







Core Objectives:Build Agentic Outbound Systems



Design and deploy AI outbound workflows that automate account sourcing, contact acquisition, research, prioritization, personalization, sequencing, and engagement orchestration






Operationalize AI at Scale





Move beyond isolated AI experiments by building repeatable, production-ready workflows that integrate across Salesforce, Marketo, Clay, sequencing platforms, enrichment providers, and engagement tools






Improve Outbound Efficiency





Reduce manual BDR work through automation while increasing outbound quality, targeting precision, personalization, and activity scalability






Accelerate Pipeline Generation





Support the evolution of JumpCloud’s outbound programs through AI targeting, signal-based prioritization, automated enrichment, and intelligent workflow orchestration






Ship Fast and Iterate





Rapidly prototype, deploy, measure, and improve GTM workflows with a strong bias toward execution and measurable business impact







We're Looking For:


A highly technical GTM operator who enjoys building systems, automations, and workflows that solve real revenue problems. This person thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable working across both strategy and execution, and prefers shipping solutions over discussing hypotheticals.




Success in this role is measured by deployed workflows and operational improvements that increase outbound efficiency, pipeline generation, or seller productivity.







Required Qualifications:


GTM Systems & Operations








Hands-on experience working within modern GTM systems including Salesforce, Marketo, Gong Engage, enrichment providers, and outbound engagement platforms.








Experience building and maintaining workflows across tools such as Clay, Openprise, Zapier, Replit, or similar orchestration platforms.








Strong understanding of outbound operations, lead/account flows, enrichment strategies, segmentation, and GTM data management.








In-depth understanding of how MCPs work and demonstrated experience applying best practices for MCP utilization and efficiency.









AI & Automation








Practical experience applying AI and automation to GTM workflows beyond experimentation.








Experience working with LLMs (preferably Claude Cowork & Code), prompt workflows, structured outputs, AI-assisted personalization, and integrating AI outputs into operational systems.








Familiarity with APIs, automation logic, webhooks, and lightweight scripting to connect systems and automate processes.








Understanding of concepts such as agentic workflows, signal-based automation, RAG, embeddings, or AI orchestration frameworks is a plus.









Builder Mentality








Proven ability to independently build and operationalize workflows from idea → deployment → iteration.








Comfortable using no-code, low-code, and lightweight coding approaches to deliver solutions quickly.








Strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to identify bottlenecks and improve workflow reliability at scale.









Cross-Functional Collaboration








Ability to partner effectively with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Data teams to align priorities and execute quickly.








Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.









Operating Style








Highly self-directed and execution-oriented with a strong bias toward action.








Comfortable operating in ambiguity and iterating quickly as priorities evolve.








Motivated by solving operational problems and building systems that create measurable business impact.


















Where you’ll be working/Location:




JumpCloud® is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.




 




This role is remote in the country of Mexico. You must be located in and authorized to work in Mexico to be considered for this role. 




 




Language: 




JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.




 




Why JumpCloud®? 




If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about. 




 




One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO




 




Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time. 




 




JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.




 




Scam Notice:




Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.




 




All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"




 




 #BI-Remote




We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

Skift is a remote-first, globally distributed company. We value clarity, accountability, and strong documentation to stay aligned across time zones.

About the job

Job Title: Social Media Content Creator | Remote

Only English CVs will be accepted.




Retalent Agency is a global remote recruitment agency that connects talented professionals like you with top companies in e-commerce, marketing, and tech. Since 2019, we’ve helped hundreds of candidates from Latin America, Eastern Europe, Asia, and South Africa land full-time remote roles with international teams.

When you apply through Retalent, you’re not just applying for a job; you’re stepping into a community of growing businesses and ambitious professionals.




Let us help you find the right opportunity to grow your career from anywhere in the world.




Our Client:




Our client has built an AI-powered operating system that runs the entire sales engagement layer for automotive dealerships, and it's already proven at scale, having worked over a million leads and booked more than 100,000 appointments.




They're changing the way sales works in automotive. The old model, broken manual follow-up loops, reps buried in busywork, is being replaced by a closed-loop system that handles the grind, so sales reps can focus on what they do best: selling and closing. Dealerships grow. The category is moving fast, and this team is right at the centre of it.




This is a pivotal moment. The company is transitioning from build mode to scale mode, and the category around AI-driven automotive sales infrastructure is exploding. If you want to join a team that's already delivering real results and help take it to the next level, the timing couldn't be better.




In This Role, You’ll:




Be the hands-on content creator behind the company’s organic social presence. Your day-to-day is the full content creation loop: editing footage, writing copy, publishing across platforms, engaging the community, and learning from the data to make the next piece better. You’ll also contribute to the editorial direction alongside the Director of Media.




What You'll Be Doing




Content Creation (~75%)

Editing raw footage into scroll-stopping short-form social media content, this is the bulk of the role
Writing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs that stop the scroll and drive action
Appearing on camera when needed as part of content
Publishing on cadence across LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Facebook, and X
In-platform engagement and community building: comments, DMs, replies, relationships
Daily co-concepting with the Director of Media
Running the content pipeline so output stays consistent and on-brand




Performance & Reporting (~25%)

Tracking key metrics: reach, engagement, watch time, follower growth, saves, and shares
Reviewing performance weekly and reporting findings clearly
Translating what’s working (and what isn’t) into better content in the next cycle
Contributing to the editorial calendar and content direction based on performance insights




What You’ll Bring:




Non-negotiable: you have hands-on experience editing short-form video for social media and have grown a real account organically (B2B, founder-led, or a company brand). You can show the content you’ve made, explain the editing choices, and prove the growth was driven by your work. This is the core of what we’re hiring for.




The rest:

Video editing proficiency: you can take raw footage and turn it into polished, engaging short-form content
Comfort on camera: you’re willing to appear in content when the role calls for it
Copywriting ability for hooks, captions, scripts, and CTAs
Platform-native knowledge: current on formats, sounds, and what performs where
Analytical instincts: you can read performance data, find the signal, and apply it to your next piece of content
Comfort with daily, high-frequency collaboration and fast feedback loops
Ownership: you bring ideas and execute without being managed to it




Nice to have: 

Experience with organic growth strategy or content attribution




Platforms and Tools:

Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube
DaVinci, Adobe Premiere (preferably DaVinci) 
Canva, Adobe Express (or Adobe Creative Suite) 
Familiarity with publishing/scheduling tools
OpusClip, SubMagic, or similar




This Role Isn't For You If




You’ve never edited short-form video for social media or feel uncomfortable in an editing-heavy role
You’re a strategist who won’t touch the work, most of the week is making and publishing content
You think only in views and impressions and have no interest in learning from performance data
You need heavy direction to set a plan and execute against it
You’re not comfortable appearing on camera




What’s In It for You:




Competitive salary: $5,000 to $7,000 USD per month.
Opportunities for learning and professional development.
100% remote position, work from anywhere
Paid Time Off: 10 days

The ideal candidate must be a strategic and creative thought leader with the ability to deliver integrated thinking; demonstrate a positive, do-what-it-takes attitude; be a natural connector who develops strong relationships among various groups, and anticipate and solve problems all while being highly organized.

Your Impact 

The Brand Account Assoc Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operation of different brand accounts for the Frito-Lay North America Team, including collaboration with internal team members and internal stakeholders to develop world-class content development. You will lead the day-to-day client business management and supervise the execution of multiple account deliverables happening simultaneously. You must be able to build upon tactical ideas and think strategically about a brand or business and partner with the creative / art team. Also, you will be managing a team of account coordinators and executives to achieve business goals.


Maintaining a high level of performance by the account team.
Strategic thinker capable of leading the development of a brand’s engagement strategy, annual plans and specific projects with multiple stakeholders including internal and external agency partners and clients.
Being sufficiently informed and personally involved, ensuring sound planning, good service and a solid client/agency relationship.
Keeping management informed of the status of his/her group’s accounts, problems, plans and meetings, as well as involving Management personnel at key times.
Weekly and Monthly reporting of deliverables, hours invested by project, A&M Productivity, and others.
Develop career plans for your team of account executives.
Provides account team leadership and conveys the specific requirements for multi-functional support to the appropriate functional regional management on a timely basis.


Qualifications

Who Are We Looking For? 


Bachelor’s degree in a directly related field (marketing, communication, advertising, etc.)
Experience with creative teams in agency or in-house agency environments; CPG Experience is a must for this role.
Marketing professional with 4+ years in agency account management and/or experience in a closely related field.
3+ years in a supervisory role.
Strong track record of demonstrating ability to oversee a range of accounts and projects with detail-oriented lens.
Strong consumer empathy & customer-centricity. Demonstrated ability to place the consumer at the heart of everything while leading creative teams and managing agency product.
Orchestrator, Influencer, non-hierarchical: Strong track record of developing and inspiring teams of marketing / creative professionals. Proven collaboration abilities, strategic thinking and leadership skills.


If this is an opportunity that interests you, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet 100% of the requirements.

What can you expect from us: 


Opportunities to learn and develop every day through a wide range of programs. 
Internal digital platforms that promote self-learning. 
Development programs according to Leadership skills. 
Specialized training according to the role. 
Learning experiences with internal and external providers. 
We love to celebrate success, which is why we have recognition programs for seniority, behavior, leadership, moments of life, among others. 
Financial wellness programs that will help you reach your goals in all stages of life. 
A flexibility program that will allow you to balance your personal and work life, adapting your working day to your lifestyle. 
And because your family is also important to us, they can also enjoy benefits such as our Wellness Line, thousands of Agreements and Discounts, Scholarship programs for your children, Aid Plans for different moments of life, among others. 


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We respect and value diversity as a work force and innovation for the organization.

About the job

About Us

Inflection Club is a private co-investment community for accredited investors, operators, and family offices who want direct access to pre-IPO deals in the companies shaping the future. Built under Catalyst Capital Holdings, we provide curated access from early to late-stage opportunities that traditionally only flow to endowments, pension funds, and institutional allocators - names like Anthropic, Polymarket, Kraken, and Lovable.

Our thesis is simple: the biggest returns of the next decade will come from companies built on the cost curves of artificial intelligence, robotics, longevity, and next-generation infrastructure. We help our members invest in those companies 12 to 18 months before they go public, deal-by-deal, with full discretion.

We are not a fund. We are a club. No blind pools, no lock-ups, no marketing dressed up as deal flow. Every member chooses what they back, and we handle everything else - sourcing, diligence, SPV formation, legal, reporting, and the live community that makes the whole thing run.

What You Will Do:

The CRM Coordinator is the operational backbone of our member and prospect pipeline. You will own the integrity and performance of our CRM - ensuring every contact, deal stage, and communication touchpoint is accurate, timed, and purposeful.

This is not a data-entry role. We need someone who understands why the data matters, takes ownership of process breakdowns before anyone else notices them, and continuously improves how we track and engage our community. You will work closely with the Director of Community & Operations to ensure no relationship falls through the cracks.

What You'll Own


 CRM Administration & Data Integrity
Own day-to-day administration of HubSpot: contact records, deal stages, pipeline accuracy, custom properties, and lifecycle stages
Maintain a single source of truth for all member and prospect data - clean, current, and actionable

 Workflows, Sequences & Automation
Build and maintain workflows, sequences, and automations that support member acquisition, engagement, and retention
Coordinate with the Partner/Origination and Managing Partner teams to ensure pipeline data reflects real-time activity
Continuously improve the CRM architecture as the club scales - new pipelines, new stages, new segments
 Reporting & Funnel Insights
Track and report on key funnel metrics: applications, conversions, member tenure, engagement signals, and re-engagement triggers
Surface insights to leadership in a clear, concise format - no noise, just signal
Build and maintain dashboards that give the team visibility into pipeline health at a glance
 List Segmentation & Campaign Coordination
Own audience segmentation and list management for outreach campaigns coordinated with the Director of Community & Operations
Ensure the right message reaches the right segment at the right time - and that results are tracked cleanly
 Member Onboarding Flows
Support the operational layer of new member onboarding - ensuring the right communications go out on schedule and that member records are updated as they move through each stage
Liaise with the Director of Community & Operations to keep onboarding workflows current and optimised


Requirements

Who You Are:


2+ years of hands-on CRM or revenue operations experience, with HubSpot as a hard requirement
You have a strong grasp of sales pipeline management, lifecycle stages, and funnel reporting - not just where to find them in a dashboard, but what they mean
You can build workflows and sequences without hand-holding. You know when automation helps and when it creates more problems than it solves
You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice when something is off, and you fix it before being asked
You are async-first and comfortable operating in a fast-moving, distributed team across time zones
You communicate clearly and concisely - in writing, always


Bonus Points


Experience in financial services, investment communities, high-ticket sales, or private membership organisations
Familiarity with Web3, DeFi, or crypto-adjacent audiences
Exposure to SPV workflows, investor relations, or regulated communications
Experience with ClickUp, Slack automation, or n8n


How We Work


Inflection Club's leadership operates on a Yin-Yang model borrowed from how our founders built Decentralized Masters. Every major initiative gets multiple sets of eyes before it ships. You will work closely with the Director of Community & Operations and surface issues early. You will own your domain. And you will be expected to set the quality bar - not wait for it to be set for you
We move quickly. We do not tolerate sloppiness. We expect the CRM to be a tool that makes the team faster and sharper, not a system people work around


Benefits


Fully remote - work from anywhere
Flexible, async-first culture with deep focus time built in
Competitive independent contractor rate commensurate with experience
Direct exposure to institutional-grade deal flow and a high-calibre investor community
Ground-floor opportunity in a private co-investment club being built to scale


Are You Ready?

This is a rare opportunity to own the operational intelligence layer of a private investment community that is growing fast and playing for the long game. If you are the kind of person who finds broken processes and fixes them before being asked - and who wants to be part of something being built to last - we want to hear from you.

Apply with your CV in English, along with a brief note on the CRM system you know best and one process improvement you have owned end-to-end. We move quickly and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates within two weeks.
